notes.title: Controller Support and Remapping
notes.content: In this update pretty much any controller you get your hands on should be supported plus you can remap actions to any button you see fit for both keyboard and controller. On top of that, the clarity of text at all resolutions has been made crystal clear. Enjoy :)

notes.title: Time Trial Leaderboards
notes.content:
If, for a long time, you thought you were the greatest castle defender of them all, the fastest archer ever or the most accurate at shooting dwarves in their marauding little faces now you can prove it. 

Each time trial level now supports Steam Leaderboards. 

See you at the top!

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards
notes.content:
Enjoy unlocking trading cards, badges, backgrounds and emoticons while playing. What better way to celebrate any occasion than a chicken drumstick emoticon.

Fried chicken had definitely been invented in medieval times...all these facts may have been painstakingly researched.
